messages:
sara (marketing): Heads-up: were green to ship tomorrow. Need final changelog link, docs canonical URLs, a bench snapshot for the blog, and confirmation of canary start time. Also want to A/B test two headlines  who can help with short variations? :sparkles:

anil (eng): Changelog is merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/899. Theres a short note about quantization fallback in the Router section.

rebecca (product): Reviewing changelog now. For A/B messaging, pass me two 1-line headlines and Ill pick the variants for the website. Marketing + Product should agree by EOD.

lee (docs): Canonical docs URLs: Getting started: https://docs.redwood.ai/getting-started, Benchmarks: https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks/launch-2026. I uploaded the embed code example with `model: redwood-std-2` and a minimal JS snippet.

sara (marketing): Great, lee — can you add a short code sample with `quantized: true` option? That helps our cost paragraph.

lee (docs): Done. Example added and captured in the single snippet: ```js
const resp = await redwood.completions.create({ model: 'redwood-std-2', prompt, quantized: true, max_tokens: 200 })
```

anil (eng): Bench numbers from last run on dedicated pool: median = 42ms/token, p95 = 185ms/token. Cost estimate ~ $0.0019 per 1k tokens with auto-batching. CSV link: https://internal.redwood.ai/benchmarks/launch-2026-runB.csv

sara (marketing): Perfect. For the headline A/B: Variant A: "Redwood Inference: Predictable, fast LLM serving at scale". Variant B: "Ship LLM features faster with predictable latency and lower cost". Feedback?

rebecca (product): Both good. Suggest swap "lower cost" -> "measurable unit economics" in B. So B2: "Ship LLM features faster with predictable latency and measurable unit economics".

anil (eng): Ops note: initial cold-KV sequences can add ~150ms to the first few tokens; we have a proactive warming job but call that out as a known behaviour in the notes. Also theres a safety fallback to `redwood-lite-2` if GPU OOM or p99 > 2s.

todd (ops): Canary plan proposal: start 09:45 PT tomorrow, 15 minute low-traffic window at 5% (smoke), then 09:55 PT 30% for 20m, final ramp to 100% at 10:20 PT. Rollback triggers: error-rate > 0.8% sustained for 4m OR p95 > 700ms for 3 consecutive 60s windows. Ill own the watch and post updates in this thread.

sara (marketing): Can we move the smoke earlier? We need the console screenshot at ~10:05 PT for the post.

todd (ops): Yep bump smoke to 09:40 PT, screenshot available at 10:05. Ill also enable a short lived read-only link to the dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/launch-2026/public-snapshot-10am (will expire +2h).

lee (docs): Ill pull the screenshot and redact internal IDs. Will upload to Confluence and share here.

rebecca (product): Webinar routing: using SFDC campaign `Q2-Launch-2026`. Ill map webinar signups to that campaign and set inbound leads to marketing@redwood.ai via webhook. If you want a separate nurture flow, say so now.

sara (marketing): Keep it on that campaign, add a UTM param for the blog CTA: utm_campaign=launch_q2_2026. For webinar CTA copy Ill draft two variants.

anil (eng): Small deploy note for docs: update quickstart examples to `max_new_tokens: 180` to avoid accidental long runs in the free-tier examples.

lee (docs): Updated. Also added a short "Known behaviors" section describing cold-KV impact and the quantized quality note.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for 1726669800. Image: gcr.io/redwood/serve:launch-2026. Will post log stream at https://deploy-logs.redwood.ai/1726669800 when live.

todd (ops): A couple of final ops items: enabling automated rollback hook on the deploy bot, and setting a temporary throttle to cap sessions at 12k concurrent for the first hour after full traffic.

sara (marketing): Timeline recap: 09:40 PT smoke (5%), 09:55 PT ramp (30%), 10:20 PT full. Post scheduled 11:00 PT. Ill include changelog, docs links, bench numbers, and the console screenshot. If anything blocks the screenshot, we can use the docs mockup.

anil (eng): All set on engineering side. Ill be available on standby during the canary window.

rebecca (product): Product sign-off complete. Ill approve the blog copy once the final headline variant is selected.

sara (marketing): Thanks team. Last asks: rebecca pick headline A/B by EOD and lee drop the screenshot link here after smoke. If no changes, were go for tomorrow. :rocket:
